mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1, indicating strengthening economic demand, boosts consumer and business confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with positive GDPC1 growth, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, signaling a tightening monetary cycle, investors anticipate reduced borrowing capacity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances with FEDFUNDS above 4.5%, or walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly, when UNRATE falls below 6% and PAYEMS growth accelerates (> 200k new jobs), a tightening labor market with rising wages boosts consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 55% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.04 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in INDPRO, signaling reduced industrial production, indicates supply chain disruptions or weakening demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in decline periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When RSAFS exceeds $350B, indicating strong retail sales, consumer confidence is high, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly, when FEDFUNDS is below 1% and CPIAUCSL growth accelerates (> 2%), an accommodative monetary policy with rising inflation expectations boosts equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 55% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.04 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 2-month increase in UNRATE, signaling a weakening labor market, reduces consumer spending power, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in increase periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
